title: Advisory delegation result
description: The output schema for every Advisory Task Kind - Review, Diagnosis, Adversarial. Its Result is prose and judgement, so nothing in it can be checked by running anything; `evidence` is what makes a finding checkable against the code instead, and Read-Before-Change (ADR-0003) rests on it.

verdict.description: The one-word answer, read against the question the Task Kind asked. For Review: `pass` - nothing worth changing; `concerns` - findings worth acting on, none of which should stop the change; `blocking` - at least one finding that should. For Diagnosis: `pass` - the cause is identified and the evidence settles it; `concerns` - a leading hypothesis the evidence does not settle; `blocking` - the cause was not found, so acting on this Result would be guessing. For Adversarial: `pass` - the claim survived the attempt to refute it; `concerns` - it holds only under conditions it did not state; `blocking` - it is refuted.

summary.description: Two or three sentences: what was examined and what came of it. Not a restatement of the findings.

findings.description: One entry per problem. An empty array is a legitimate Result - inventing findings to look thorough is worse than none.

severity.description: How much damage the finding does if it is real and left alone.

title.description: One line naming the problem, not the file.

body.description: What is wrong and why it matters, in enough detail for a reader who has not read the code.

file.description: Repository-relative path the finding is in, or null when it is about the change as a whole.

line_start.description: First line of the offending code, 1-indexed, or null when the finding has no single location.

line_end.description: Last line of the offending code, 1-indexed, or null when the finding has no single location.

evidence.description: The offending code, copied verbatim from the file - never a paraphrase, a reconstruction, or a description of it. The Orchestrator checks this snippet against the named file before acting on the finding, so a snippet that does not appear there costs the whole finding.

confidence.description: How sure the finding is real, 0 to 1. Below 0.5 says the reader should check first.

recommendation.description: What to do about it, specific enough to act on.

next_steps.description: What the Orchestrator should do next, beyond the per-finding recommendations. Empty when the findings say it all.
